entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf born to lord over the lower races who emerges disfigured after a ritual goes awry and is hunted by his own people.

events.summary: A desperate ritual goes awry and Rhys emerges disfigured, hunted by his own people.
events.quote: But then a desperate ritual goes awry and he emerges disfigured, a blight upon the eyes of the beautiful.
